pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, non-linear edge gradients. Patch spatial area varies, showing a gradient from larger, more elongated shapes on the lower neck/shoulder to smaller, more condensed polygons on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming an interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Corridor pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but exhibits slight narrowing at high-density junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, manifesting as fine textural projections against the background.
